scope: Everything in the app can now be done by voice and by keyboard. The guide gives both ways for each task.

topics.title: A key for every voice command
details: Things you could only say now have a key too. Things you could only press now have a spoken command.
F12 puts the microphone to sleep on any main screen. On the sleep screen, F12 wakes it.
On the main menu: Control+Shift+V tells the version. Control+Shift+M tells the mode. Control+Shift+G opens the user guides. Control+Shift+T starts the tutorial.
F1 gives help on each screen.

topics.title: Email keys
details: In the inbox, Control+O lists your saved email drafts. You can also say Open email draft.
Control+K lists your contacts. Control+Shift+K adds a contact.
Control+Shift+I tells which folder you are in. Control+I gives message details.
Page Down and Page Up move through the message list a page at a time.

topics.title: Web, help and tutorial keys
details: On a web page, Control+F finds words. F8 lists the fields.
In a Help topic, Control+Down Arrow and Control+Up Arrow move one sentence at a time.
In the tutorial, Control+Shift+R repeats. F1 lists the commands. Control+L lists the lessons.

topics.title: The guide
details: Each task in the guide now gives the spoken command and the key. For example: Say Read paragraph, or press Alt, 5, then B.
Keys are now written as Control, not Ctrl, so they are read clearly.

topics.title: Radio and email
details: Radio station actions now have spoken names. For example, say Add to favorites.
List email drafts now works from the inbox. Before, it only gave a help message.
Email options have a new Connect Google Contacts button.

topics.title: Browser extension
details: The browser extension did not change. You do not need to reload it.
